author: Rubin Shrestha
review_text: Very disappointing experience with eSewa. I no longer find it to be a trustworthy, accountable, or reliable digital wallet. When issues arise, resolving them can be slow and frustrating, and customer support does not always provide timely or satisfactory solutions. A financial service should prioritize transparency, accountability, and user confidence, but my experience has fallen short of these expectations.I hope eSewa improves its service quality and support. Till then big NO to Esewa.
